observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option, a new counter, and a new async read-repair path. The read-repair path is best-effort, detached, and does not block the request. It writes an S3 hit back into Redis with a short TTL, using SET NX to avoid overwriting existing entries. It is disabled for etag-enabled namespaces and capped at 3600s. observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce cold-cache S3 reads for the Rust reader, potentially lowering latency and S3 cost. The tier is bounded by the short TTL and the fact that it does not register in the expiry sorted set, so Django's refresh job remains the only owner of an entry's real lifetime.
